A Photoshoot and the Abandoned Thrifty Megamart (Japanese: 撮影！！メガやすの跡地！ Photograph! The Abandoned !) is the 16th chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
 
==Major events==
Faba and Wicke give , Professor Kukui, and Professor Burnet a tour of Aether Paradise.
After hearing the Trial Captains are going to meet with Team Skull, Faba heads off to inform Lusamine.
Acerola properly introduces herself to and Lillie.
Acerola tells Sun that if he wants to meet with , he'll need to complete her trial first.
Sun is given the task of photographing the Pokémon that lives inside of the abandoned and gives him a camera to complete the task.
After finding the Totem, a , Sun battles against it, but the camera ends up getting destroyed.
Rotom reveals that it got dragged along when Sun went to rescue Lillie earlier and lets Sun use its Poké Finder function to replace the broken camera.
At the , Ilima agrees to help Mallow and the others meet with Team Skull.
Hau appears at the Trainers' School to meet with Ilima and is revealed to have obtained a .
Sina and Dexio arrive on Ula'ula Island to find someone that can help with their search for 's scattered across Alola.
